# 🛠️ Dual-Agent Harness
**skill** · shared · knowledge

The shareable soulbis ⚔️ ⊥ soulbae 🧙 skeleton (~/dual-agent-harness · rebuilt 2026-07-09, supersedes the v1.0 extraction): six-phase loop Measure → Propose → Hold-apart → Assay → Critic → Chronicle, seven seats, the six PVM trusts in TRUSTS.md, conform.mjs proving (⚔️⊥⿻⊥🧙)😊 = neg ⊕ bnot → succ on Z/64Z. The Gap ⿻ derives held-out witnesses by hashing the proposal together with a run secret the proposer never sees (non-collusion invariant I(Y_S;Y_M|X)=0); verdicts are VALIDATED / MIRAGE / BLOCKED; only the keystone folds, only the First Person publishes. Fifteen instances stand in HARNESS_PATHS.md — the origin fleet, the operator's work WITH the harness kept apart from the system (accessions to sixteen, one withdrawn; #1 shor_mage · ecdsa.fail, #2 myterms · the browser-extension pair, #3 the V6 rehydration pipeline, #4 privacy_pools_v2_mage · first mechanically fitted, #5 lexon_pvm · the grammar workshop, #14 the DTG verification registry · first external run accepted, #16 uor_kappa_mage · the constitution inherited whole). Its own field-guide spar folded 730 → 573 → 526 → 472 words across three audited folds, the last two keystone-census 32/32. Built for trust-graph construction: a gated result seals as a κ-addressed holon; a derived edge proposes, only a VRC signature mints (GRAPH.md).
